{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data contains customer_age
assert 'customer_age' in df.columns, "Data does not contain customer_age column"

# Confirm the missing age sentinel is -1
missing_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Filter out missing age values
valid_age_df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print only the mean value (as required for grounding)
print(mean_age)"}
